method: Scenarios are the intentionally vulnerable setups named in Kubernetes Goat's public scenario list. Only scenarios whose weakness is visible in a static manifest or Dockerfile are included; runtime-only scenarios (e.g. SSRF in the app, NodePort discovery, crypto-miner analysis, tool demos such as Falco or Popeye) and Helm templates are excluded. The mapping to Assay rule IDs was written by the builder (AI-assisted) and is not an independent label set.
